question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%moisture%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%ppm%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%120 %' OR lower(text) LIKE '%120°%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%water content%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%karl%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, kind, page, left(text,300) AS t FROM atoms WHERE lower(text) LIKE '%moisture%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%drying%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%dried%' OR lower(text) LIKE '%ppm%' ORDER BY page
SELECT id, page, line_no, text FROM lines WHERE page=8 AND line_no BETWEEN 49 AND 62 ORDER BY line_no

WITH v AS (SELECT (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L54') AS t54, (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L59') AS t59, (SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p8.L56') AS t56) SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(t54,'and ([0-9]+) ppm',1) AS INTEGER) - CAST(regexp_extract(t59,'and ([0-9]+) ppm',1) AS INTEGER) AS water_loss_ppm, CAST(regexp_extract(t56,'reduced to ([0-9]+) ppm',1) AS INTEGER) - CAST(regexp_extract(t59,'and ([0-9]+) ppm',1) AS INTEGER) AS gap_vs_nmp_ppm FROM v
